dataset.target: net option P&L after estimated costs > 0
dataset.signal_timing: all index, option-chain and model-derived Greek predictors are from the prior completed SENSEX session
dataset.greeks: Black-Scholes approximations from prior-session option close and index close; 6.5% risk-free rate, no dividend yield; missing/invalid IV remains null

selection_rule: Choose the classifier with the highest validation one-trade-per-session expectancy return, subject to at least the configured number of validation trades. The threshold is selected from the predeclared grid. The final holdout is not used for model or threshold selection.
holdout_selection: At most one highest-probability candidate per entry session; one-session holding period; no overlapping positions.
drawdown_basis: compounded premium-return index, base 100; per-trade loss floored at -100%; not a cash-account return
execution_caveat: BSE bhavcopy contains daily OHLC, volume and open interest, not timestamped bid/ask quotes. The target uses observed EOD close-to-close premiums with conservative estimated costs; it is not a quote-level executable return.
research_warning: Model selection across several candidates creates selection bias. Treat the holdout as one historical diagnostic, not a guarantee. A genuinely prospective paper period is needed to test stability after research choices are frozen.
